assistantMessages.text: I’ll inspect the place in Google Maps, capture the viewport, then compare directions and public transit options and capture the route view. I’ll stop if authentication or consent requires your input.

The first screenshot shows a close neighborhood view at a 100 m scale, with the place panel on the left and the destination pin in the green reserve. The screenshot initially hit a stale-observation error; the single fresh-inspection retry succeeded. I’m now setting the airport as the origin.

Transit was already selected, and Maps lists six options ranging from 1 hr 39 min to 2 hr 12 min, with a warning that timetables may be outdated. The second screenshot succeeded after one fresh-inspection retry. It also shows a survey with consent language; I’ll hand control to you and stop without responding to it.
